policy: Each file is one concrete escaped failure family. Feature matrices and migration-only behavior checks belong elsewhere.

files.subject: fix: handle chat aborts as terminal turns (#161)
files.failure: A chat abort must finish as a terminal turn and release its worker instead of hanging.

files.subject: fix(chat): defer inbound acceptance until turn start
files.failure: Inbound chat delivery must not be acknowledged before the turn actually starts.

files.subject: fix(chat): recover missed inbound messages
files.failure: Persisted inbound chat events must recover after runtime interruption without being lost.

files.subject: fix(daemon): preserve chat turns across normal restart
files.failure: A managed daemon restart must not classify its active chat worker as a terminal worker exit.

files.subject: fix(rin): let restart activation interrupt active turns
files.failure: Restart activation must interrupt an active turn instead of waiting behind it.

files.subject: fix: prevent multiple rin daemons (#409)
files.failure: A second daemon process must fail while the owning daemon lock is live.

files.subject: fix(rin): avoid resuming incomplete assistant tool calls
files.failure: RPC resume must not continue an assistant message that ended with an incomplete tool call.

files.subject: fix(rpc): wait through websocket recovery after thrown errors
files.failure: RPC mode must wait through recoverable websocket errors instead of terminating the turn.
